A.name: language advantage
A.claim: Seloryn's typed semantics and diagnostics reduce invalid states and semantic rework on bounded AI-development tasks.
A.decision_rule: Report separately from B; require paired provider observations and independent acceptance evidence. Otherwise conclude inconclusive.

B.name: ecosystem advantage
B.claim: Seloryn's project, editor, receipts, lifecycle and documentation tooling reduce integration and maintenance rework.
B.decision_rule: Report separately from A; require paired provider observations and independent acceptance evidence. Otherwise conclude inconclusive.

tool_parity.context: same frozen task prompt, same baseline commit, same repository snapshot and same declared time budget
tool_parity.human_intervention: provider-reported typed events only; absent data is unknown, not zero

measurement_contract.token_policy: Copy provider values exactly. Do not estimate, sum or backfill input/output/total tokens.
measurement_contract.cost_policy: Copy provider cost exactly. Do not derive price from a model name or token count.
measurement_contract.regression_policy: Copy provider-declared regression observations. Acceptance results are not regression results.
measurement_contract.retention: Store only the bounded metadata required for comparison; raw prompts, outputs, hidden reasoning and credentials are out of scope.
